references.text: Specifies the service age for Levites from thirty to fifty years, which is the broader context for the retirement age mentioned in 8:25.
Confirms that the Levites were to begin their service at twenty-five years of age and serve at the tent of meeting.
Summarizes the age limits for Levitical service, from thirty to fifty years, relevant to the retirement provision.
The preceding verse which states the starting age for Levitical service at twenty-five years.
The following verse which explains what the retired Levites could still do - assist their brothers.
